basic_details.short_information: National Council of Science Museums (NCSM) Trainee Craft (Electronics) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the National Council of Science Museums (NCSM) on its official website for the recruitment of 1 Trainee Craft (Electronics) post under Advertisement No. 14/2026. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for eligible candidates to join on a temporary basis through a walk-in selection process.

content_sections.heading: NCSM Trainee Craft Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NCSM Trainee Craft (Electronics) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: NCSM Trainee Craft Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NCSM Trainee Craft (Electronics) posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 28th July 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue by 10:00 AM sharp for registration.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Trainee Craft (Electronics) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed SSC or Matriculation with a certificate from ITI or an equivalent discipline to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Trainee Craft (Electronics) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 22,000/- per month for the duration of their traineeship.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Trainee Craft (Electronics) recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is open for fresh eligible candidates who have passed out on or after 1st January 2023.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Trainee Craft (Electronics) position at NCSM?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates need to appear directly for the walk-in written test and trade test at the specified venue and date.

faq.question: Q6. What documents do I need to carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates and testimonials, a duly filled application form, identity proof, and a set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for NCSM Trainee Craft (Electronics) going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at National Council of Science Museums, 33-Block-GN, Sector-V, Salt Lake City, Kolkata- 700091.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Trainee Craft (Electronics) post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a walk-in written test followed by a trade test to assess the candidates' suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or temporary job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Trainee Craft (Electronics) position is temporary, offering a stipend during the training period.
